overview: On the third sheet you sent for the glass, had it looked in, and broke it. The three sheets were done. You had not walked once. The prison was still unwritten, and so was the end. The chronicle was still shut.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the glass in three beats and stopped.

assets.name: Richard II
assets.disposition: Broke the glass on the page

summary: Broke the glass on the page
